name: task-generation
description: Turns an existing Product Requirements Prompt at .ai/[feature]/prp.md into a step-by-step task list of parent tasks and sub-tasks, saved to .ai/[feature]/tasks.md and committed. Use when a PRP is ready to be broken down into implementable work, or when planning how a feature will be built before any implementation starts. To write the PRP itself first, use prp- generation.
